parsedVerdict.reasoning: OrderController is an Express HTTP adapter, which is an infrastructure responsibility. It defines routes, reads body, query and params, checks that the status value and order id are present and well-formed, sets HTTP status codes, and returns JSON. It delegates to OrderService and CatalogueService. The checks (isOrderStatus, singleValue, and the status checks in GET /orders and PATCH /orders/:id/status) are transport-boundary input checks, not business rules such as pricing, stock or transition validity. Those stay in the application services. The file has no persistence logic and makes no domain decisions.
